mfp.demo.bench-press.text: Flat bench, feet on the floor, hands holding the bar above the chest.
The bar lowers toward the chest, then is pressed upward.
Another controlled lowering and press; setup stays on the bench.

mfp.demo.deadlift.text: With both hands on the bar, the lifter bends at hips and knees.
The lifter stands with the bar close to the legs, then lowers it.
The lift repeats, returning to a standing position with the bar.

mfp.demo.squat.text: A bar rests across the upper back; the lifter bends hips and knees.
The lifter returns toward standing with the bar held on the back.
The squat repeats, lowering into a bent-knee position.

mfp.demo.bent-over-row.text: The lifter hinges forward and holds the bar with both hands.
The bar is pulled toward the torso, then lowered.
The rowing motion repeats while the torso stays bent forward.
